case_inputs: Each case uses the v1 pinned synthetic ModelArgs, seed, and token sequence, with only value_scale varied.

calibration_gates: every baseline full-forward and cached case fails as wrong_output
every exact-known-fix full-forward and cached case passes
constant-0.5 mutant fails at 0.25 and 0.8 but passes both paths at 0.5
post-cache-scaling mutant passes every full-forward case and fails every cached case as wrong_output
pinned source swap is rejected by commit identity
source inventory, all source bytes, hidden Git index flags, candidate path and dependency alterations are rejected
v7 calibration failure is retained as historical evidence; v8 corrected cache-mutant generator preserves the no-cache branch and must pass all full cases while failing all cached cases
unversioned export_candidate and grade_workspace entrypoints dispatch to the v9 protocol
the v9 evaluator hash lock covers all transitive local evaluator modules and verifies hidden Git index flags for every locked input
evaluation.success: Only exact expected per-case outcomes pass. The post-cache mutant must pass all no-cache full-forward cases and fail all cached cases; crash, timeout, import failure, malformed output, and infrastructure errors never count as semantic rejection.

grader_semantics: Pinned manifest and Git object checks verify every upstream Python module before export. Candidate workspace inventory permits edits only to the task target. Full-forward and incremental-cache results are graded independently for each value scale in one session function.
limitations: One random small-model Development-task calibration; no Coding-Agent rollout or model capability claim.
Only the selected upstream function/model contract is tested.
v7 calibration failed because its cache-mutant generator also altered the no-cache rotary-position branch; v8 does not reinterpret that run.
v8 calibration used versioned calls but did not bind the public dispatcher or all transitive evaluator imports; v9 recalibrates after those trust-boundary fixes.
